_comment: BACKFILL built on 2026-10-12 for a week the scheduled routine missed (24 Aug - 5 Oct it could not push). Every value is point-in-time as of the report's Friday close; the build cuts the Shiller CSV and FRED data at the report date. The Buffett indicator has no dated gurufocus reading in this span, so it is carried from the previous report and marked stale.

spx_current.source: S&P 500 close 2026-09-18 (from a week-ahead piece citing the 4pm close), two days after the first Fed hike since 2023 (https://ts2.tech/en/stock-market-week-ahead-sp-500-at-7650-meets-a-5-treasury-yield/)

fred_fallback.source: FRED series via equibles.com mirrors, all for 2026-09-18: DGS10 5.01%, T10Y2Y +0.25, HY OAS 2.68% = 268bps

fed.stance: HIKED 25bps to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16, 12-0 - the first increase since 2023. Warsh: 'removing accommodation', no forward guidance; median dot 4.125% end-2026, 16 of 18 officials see at least one more 2026 hike
fed.read: the headwind became an actual tightening; October hike odds ~51% on 09-17

sentiment_updates.name: Yardeni
sentiment_updates.note: DOWNGRADE: the Street-high bull cut his own target; bearish-scenario odds raised from 20% to 30% on 09-12

statement.summary: Cut YE S&P target 8,400 -> 7,900, 'proceed with caution' as the 10y passed 5%

sentiment_updates.name: Lee
sentiment_updates.note: Held: the loudest bull, now openly split from Yardeni

statement.summary: CNBC Closing Bell: S&P could 'easily be above 8,200 by the end of the year' as long as the AI trade isn't extinguished; Q4 'one of the biggest rallies'

sentiment_updates.name: Sonders
sentiment_updates.note: Held: probably not one-and-done, but not a long cycle either

statement.summary: Schwab Market Perspective: stocks fell sharply after Warsh's press conference; slow hiking cycles have historically produced milder declines

sentiment_updates.name: Dimon
sentiment_updates.note: Held: inflation 'not clear it's over'; prepare for rate volatility; no recession call

statement.summary: Yahoo Finance interview hours after the hike: 'it's not clear to me it's over yet'; 'a lot of things out there which are quite dangerous'

sentiment_updates.name: Slok
sentiment_updates.note: Held: backs the hike, no equity call (summary from headline only)

statement.summary: CNBC: 'Market clearly saying the Fed rate hike was a good decision'

sentiment_updates.name: Rosenberg
sentiment_updates.note: Held: bonds over stocks, a recession surprise ahead; talk only, no positioning

statement.summary: Kitco interview: one hike is not a mistake but four or five would be; 'block your nose and buy' Treasuries; expects bonds to outperform stocks within months

reading_list.title: FOMC statement, September 16, 2026
reading_list.why: The first hike since 2023, 12-0 - the 10y crossed 5% the same week, moving the Excess CAPE Yield and curve tiles

reading_list.title: Proceed With Caution
reading_list.why: The Street-high bull cutting his own target - the first big roster move of the hiking cycle

fiscal.source: CBO August Monthly Budget Review (09-09): $2.0tn deficit over 11 months; full-year projection ~5.8% of GDP. Debt/GDP 122.6% is the Q1-2026 GFDEGDQ188S print
